run_gui_server: run the ARE simulation GUI server on localhost:8080 with a specified scenario ID
run_gui_server_with_ssl: run the ARE simulation GUI server with SSL certificate and key file paths
run_gui_server_with_profiler: run the ARE simulation GUI server with cProfile profiler enabled for performance analysis
run_gui_server_with_dataset: run the ARE simulation GUI server loading scenarios from a custom dataset directory path
run_gui_server_with_custom_view: run the ARE simulation GUI server starting in a specific UI view like SCENARIOS or PLAYGROUND
